description: This file defines the PdfContents class, which manages a collection of PDF content streams within a PDF page in the PDFsharp library. It provides methods to append, prepend, replace, and combine content streams, as well as enumerator support for iteration.

classes.name: PdfContents
classes.description: Represents an array of PDF content streams, providing methods to manipulate and iterate over content streams within a PDF page.

methods.name: PdfContents
methods.description: Constructor initializing PdfContents with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfContents
methods.description: Constructor initializing PdfContents from an existing PdfArray.

methods.name: AppendContent
methods.description: Appends a new content stream to the collection and returns it.

methods.name: PrependContent
methods.description: Prepends a new content stream to the collection and returns it.

methods.name: CreateSingleContent
methods.description: Creates a single combined content stream from all existing streams without modifying the original streams.

methods.name: ReplaceContent
methods.description: Replaces current content streams with a sequence of new content.

methods.name: ReplaceContent
methods.description: Replaces current content streams with a new set of bytes.

methods.name: SetModified
methods.description: Marks the content collection as modified and updates the streams accordingly.
